app.title: KrishiMix
app.subtitle: Intercropping Decision System & Planting Layouts
app.tagline: Science-backed crop pairing for higher land productivity

speech.step1: Step 1: Choose your agricultural season and enter your district. KrishiMix will automatically detect your regional soil type and rainfall zone.
speech.step2: Step 2: Enter your land area in acres or physical field dimensions in meters. You can also visually choose your field shape or upload a boundary photo.
speech.step3: Step 3: Verify soil type, soil pH level, and irrigation source. If soil pH is extreme, corrective advice will be shown.
speech.step4: Step 4: Select your primary cereal crop and companion pulse variety. Make sure to pick complementary crops, not the same crop.
speech.step5: Step 5: Review your scientific intercropping verdict, Land Productivity Score, scale planting blueprint, input cost estimate, and realistic production risk levels.
speech.compare: Compare Screen: Compare multiple intercrop configurations side by side, including university benchmarks, high-risk warnings, and your own saved farm plans.
speech.saved: Saved Plans: Access your farm plans saved on this device. You can view, compare selected plans, or print summaries.
speech.admin: Admin Panel: Upload research station trial CSV files, inspect dataset integrity, and retrain machine learning models.

disclaimer.title: Realistic Production & Earnings Notice
disclaimer.text: Profits and yields shown are research trial benchmarks under scientific management. Actual farm returns are NOT guaranteed and vary widely with rainfall timing, pest outbreaks, weed control, local input costs, and mandi auction market prices.

risks.title: Realistic Production Risk Assessment
risks.subtitle: Direct biological and financial factors under actual farming conditions:
risks.drought_desc: If monsoon pauses for more than 10-14 days during flowering, rainfed yields can decline by 25-40%. Both crops compete for the same moisture pool.
risks.pest_desc: Host insects like pod borer (Helicoverpa) and sucking aphids can migrate between adjacent crop rows. Regular scouting is essential.
risks.shading_desc: If the main cereal grows significantly faster or the companion pulse is sown late, the lower crop can suffer up to 30% sunlight starvation.
risks.market_desc: Local mandi prices often dip during peak post-harvest arrivals. Maximum net profit requires access to MSP procurement or temporary crop storage.

step2.east_west_desc: Used when field contour slope requires cross-slope furrowing

step2.shape_trapezoid_desc: Uneven field boundary with tapered edges
step2.shape_contour_desc: Curved or sloped boundary following land contours

step3.title: Soil Condition & Irrigation
step3.desc: Incompatible root moisture and pH will automatically trigger safety warnings.
step3.ph_warning_acidic: ⚠️ Severe Acidity (pH < 5.5): High aluminium toxicity risk. Apply agricultural lime (200-400 kg/acre) before sowing.
step3.ph_warning_alkaline: ⚠️ Severe Alkalinity (pH > 8.2): Zinc and iron deficiency likely. Apply gypsum and zinc sulphate.

step4.title: Choose Crops & Varieties
step4.desc: Intercrop success depends on height harmony, maturity timing, and biological synergy.
step4.same_crop_error: ❌ Incompatible Pairing: Crop A and Crop B cannot be the identical crop. Intercropping requires two different complementary species (e.g. Cereal + Pulse).

simple_terms.sunlight: Sunlight Sharing: Tall crop + Short bush
simple_terms.maturity: Maturity Duration: Harvest at different times

report.title: Farmer One-Page Summary Report
report.subtitle: Clear, practical sowing instructions for your field
report.rule1: Sow the companion pulse on the same day or within 3 days of sowing the main crop.
report.rule2: Scout weekly for pod borer caterpillars during flowering and pod development.
report.rule3: Keep furrows clean and weed-free for the first 35 days until the pulse forms a ground cover.
